text:
maya: Pushing a canary for orpheus-14b:int4v2 -> quant-hybrid-2. Noticed weird token drift after ~8k tokens.
sam: got it. what's the test plan?
maya: running long-context regression suite (longprefill + streaming) up to 24k tokens. seeing divergence after ~8.2k tokens on canary only :thinking:
eli: can you paste the convo snippet and loss/entropy diffs?
maya: log snippet:
```bash
# reproduce
./run_eval.sh --model orpheus-14b:quant-hybrid-2 --prompt-file longprefill_pairs.json --max-tokens 24000 --batch 1
```
maya: loss delta at step 8203: baseline=1.23, canary=1.47
maya: fingerprints: baseline=3f9a7c..., canary=3f9b2d... diverging around 8190-8205
sam: sounds like a RoPE scaling / position index wrap. Did quant change posscale or clip?
maya: quant config shows posscale_clip=1.0 -> unchanged, but noticed `rotary_scale` fallback on int4 kernel to 0.998 on some shards
tasha: @maya can you dump KV indices around token 8192? use `kv_dump --range 8176:8216`
maya: dumped. excerpt:
```
[8190] shard0 idx=8190 key=0x7fabc... val_len=1024
[8191] shard0 idx=8191 key=0x7fabd... val_len=1024
[8192] shard0 idx= -4095  key=0x0000... val_len=0  <-- suspicious wrap
```
lee: -4095 idx suggests signed overflow when casting to int16 in the _kv_index_pack path
eli: did we change any memcpy/packing in quantized memcpy for int4 path? @sam
sam: yeah, last week I landed an optimization that uses int16 index shorting for ptx kernels. may not handle >8192 windows
maya: reproducer attached: minimal prompt to hit at 8200 tokens in CI run (small input + repeated filler)
ci-bot: [run 2024-02-22T17:02:10Z] scheduled longprefill-eval on canary (id: 8773)
ci-bot: [workflow] step: collect-kv-dumps
maya: hypothesis: int16 index overflow + rotary_scale fallback combine to produce incorrect alignments -> token shift
tasha: quick mitigation: clamp window index to uint32 in packing layer and force rotary_scale to 1.0 on canary. Can someone patch and retest?
sam: on it, sending PR
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5421 - fixes packing to use u32 and adds assert
sam: deployed patch to canary
ci-bot: [run 2024-02-22T17:14:43Z] rerun started (id: 8774)
maya: rerun shows loss delta reduced: baseline=1.23, canary=1.26 at 8203 :relieved:
eli: good. do a bisect to check which change introduced packing assumption
maya: planning full sweep with pinned quant config across shards and a longer flight (30k tokens) overnight
tasha: add a monitoring alert: if kv_index < 0 or val_len==0 after prefills then fail-fast
lee: logging patch landed
maya: great work. will follow up with bench results mañana
sam: note for onboarding doc: call out int16 index caution for >8k windows in quantized kernels
maya: thanks all :sparkles:
